First public release of Dokito, a local Markdown workspace for product context,
projects, tasks, and coding agents.

Highlights:

- Keep durable context in plain, Git-versioned Markdown Areas.
- Connect one Area to multiple existing code repositories.
- Resolve the same context from any registered repository checkout.
- Share Resources, Projects, and Tasks between people and coding agents.
- Browse the workspace through a local, read-only Web view.
- Install the bundled skill with the open agent skills CLI.

The release includes:

- signed and notarized macOS binaries for Apple silicon and Intel Macs;
- Linux binaries for arm64 and x64;
- a standalone agent skill archive; and
- SHA-256 checksums for every download.

Dokito is free under Apache-2.0 and has no cloud service, database, accounts,
or telemetry.

This is early-stage software. Windows has not been verified, the Web view is
read-only, and file formats may change between releases.
